🎉 Hall of Glory: Eggy Training Master Phase 1
Winners! 🎉
Thank you all for joining the event!
Your hero tips, lineup ideas, strategies, and gameplay
advice have helped Eggy learn a lot. Eggy is getting
smarter and will be able to help more new Lords in
the future! ✨
Congratulations to the 16 outstanding Lords who won
rewards!

🔥 Phase 2 Coming Soon! 🔥
Eggy still has more to learn. Phase 2 is already being
prepared, with more mystery rewards waiting for you.
Keep sharing your useful tips and stay tuned to the
official community for the next announcement!
Let’s keep training Eggy together! 💪🐔

Oops… you didn’t see me. I was never here. 🌿
While playing Top Heroes, have you ever had a
moment that made you want to quietly back into the
bushes and pretend nothing happened? 👀
Maybe you thought, “I’ve got this,” but the enemy
was way stronger than expected… 😭
Come share your “I’m just gonna pretend I wasn’t
here” moment with us!

📅 Event Time
October 26 – November 2
🎁 Reward Distribution
Starting November 3

📝 How to Participate
1. Leave a comment starting with:
“When I ______”
2. Share your funny or relatable Top Heroes moment.
Include your:
In-Game Name + Server ID
If you see a comment you relate to, feel free to react
with an emoji 😂

🏆 Rewards
We will randomly select 10 Lords from the comments
to win: $4.99 Gold Block reward

Share your most relatable Top Heroes moment with
us!
